description: The full per-run user message, verbatim. Covers a fully-populated run, an evening refresh, a cold start where every optional input is absent, and a deployment with no ground stations configured. The cold start matters most, because each 'Unavailable' string is what stops a gap being read as a measurement — and the last case is its mirror: where a source was never configured, the block is absent rather than reported unavailable.
